title: US-Iran Peace Deal Reached — Diplomatic Normalization Reshapes Iran's World Cup Bid
detail: A US-Iran peace deal has been reached, with analysts noting its sweeping diplomatic normalization implications. Reporting examined the deal's impact on Iran's participation in the 2026 FIFA World Cup, which is co-hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico — a scenario that had previously raised concerns about Iranian athletes entering US territory under sanctions.

media.caption: US-Iran peace deal and its implications for Iran's 2026 World Cup campaign
